data.name: Carbon Neutral Initiative
data.description: Carbon Neutral Initiative (CNI) is a Dutch company founded by Robert van der Luijt and Peter-Paul Laarhuis focused on permanently removing CO2 from the atmosphere. The company specializes in enhanced weathering applied to green roofs and garden soil, and is setting up a 9-hectare Enhanced Weathering project in Georgetown, Guyana with the aim to remove 1,200 tons of CO2.
